files.notes: giải thích nhẹ, thưa, chừa dải giọng nói

prompt_used: Six instrumental background music beds for a premium AI-education YouTube channel, all sharing one sonic identity with the channel logo: (1) curious playful intro, (2) light explaining bed under voice-over (sparse, mid-range kept clear for speech), (3) building tension, (4) climax/reveal, (5) calm reflective breath, (6) happy uplifting outro. Modern, warm, premium, no vocals, each loopable. Synthesized programmatically with a repeating 4-chord pattern in C major, pad + pluck arpeggio + soft kick/hat where appropriate.
issues: Synthesized programmatically, not a studio band performance; each bed is a repeating 4-bar chord pattern, so loopability comes from pattern repetition. No separate stems were produced.
